decision.summary: A multi-axis upward step begins sharply around index 622–624 (U most prominent), with coherent but unequal offsets across N/E/U. The offset remains sustained through the end of the allowed context (665); no return is observed. Pre-event trend is stable; post-event levels are elevated without recovery. Due to absence of opposing return, the interval is classified as uncertain temporary offset. A prior large downward step near index 575 lies outside allowed_context and is not included.
